_about: Fictional, hand-written example emails (all .example domains) and one-line label descriptions. Ships in the binary; contains no data from any real mailbox.

descriptions.Primary: A personal email a person wrote directly to me about a specific personal or work matter, expecting a reply.
descriptions.Updates: An automated account, security or transaction notice: password reset, verification code, sign-in alert, receipt, order confirmation, shipping update, invoice, statement, service status or policy change.
descriptions.Promotions: Marketing email: a sale, discount, special offer, retail newsletter, upgrade pitch or fundraising appeal.
descriptions.Social: A social network or community platform notification: new follower, comment, reply, friend request, tag, profile view, group post or event invitation.
